Business domain

The business area accountable for the meaning and priorities of a set of data.

Has a named owner, coordinates its subdomains and respects the ecosystem's common baseline. It need not match the organisation chart: it follows who decides on the meaning of the data.

Example

Finance; Customer service; Professional registration; Inspection.

Domain owner — Accountable for the domain; sponsors the use case and decides escalated approvals.

Coordinating steward — Coordinates the stewards' work and resolves questions across subdomains.

What shows this concept exists in practice:

  • Domain charter
  • Named owner
  • Domain glossary

In the market: Data domain · business domain (Data Mesh)

In KDV: Hive

Why this name? The hive: an autonomous unit with its own organisation that contributes to the whole.

One possible software implementation

KDV Studio/Cloud is one example of software bringing together the modules needed to support KDV: consumption, publishing, ecosystem governance, platform operations, service desk and integrations. It is optional; the Framework can be applied with other tools. This example is not a purchasing recommendation.

AI, GDPR and LGPD

Data for AI with explicit limits of use.

Define purpose, inputs, outputs and human review. A catalogue or AI connector is not enough.

01

Purpose and authority

Record purpose and who authorises each use.

02

Minimisation and access

Limit data and privileges, including derived results.

03

Origin and evaluation

Record sources, freshness, limitations and response quality.

04

People and rights

Plan review, challenges, incidents and data subject rights.
